text17: Our Al-powered translations are accurate and fast, making AI Manga Translator the perfect tool for reliable translation. Try it out for free now and see the benefits of our technology for yourself.
text20: With the help of AI Manga Translator, you can easily translate raw comics and scanned comic images, regardless of the original language of the text. We support multiple languages
text23: Get accurate, high-quality comic translations with AI Comics Translator. Our AI tools use DeepL and LLM’s API to provide the best results. Our free plan offers 10 translation opportunities per week, and you can subscribe as a member to fulfill additional requests. Please support the maintenance and improvement of our service.
problem1: Can I use AI Manga Translator for free?
reply1: Each translation consumes LLM tokens, which are not free. New accounts are eligible for 10 free translation opportunities as part of our free plan. If you’d like more translation opportunities, you can sign up as a member on our pricing page to access additional translation options.
reply2: Open AI Manga Translator, select your desired language and translation model, and click 'Translate'. With the help of AI-powered translation and text detection, AI Manga Translator makes it easy to understand manga in any language.
reply3: If you're having trouble with AI Manga Translator not responding, there are a few simple steps you can try. First, refresh the page, then re-upload the image and wait for translation.If you still encounter problems, please feel free to contact our support team at support@aimangatranslator.com for help.
problem4: How can I contact AI Manga Translator customer support?
reply4: You can contact our customer support team by emailing support@aimangatranslator.com . Our team will be happy to help you with any questions or issues you may have.
problem5: Which languages are supported by the web?
reply5: AI Manga Translator support all languages supported by Google.
problem6: Is it possible to modify a translation?
reply6: Unfortunately, it is not possible to modify a translation. We use GPT and Gemini translation model, which is artificial intelligence-based translation tool. This allows us to achieve almost perfect translations, much better than those produced by other translation tools such as Google Translate.
reply7: We offer two payment options: PayPal and Stripe. You can choose whichever you prefer.Important:When you make a payment, please make sure that the email you use matches the email you use to log in to our AI Manga Translator website. This email is how we recognize your membership. If the emails match, our system will automatically activate your membership. If they don’t match, you’ll need to contact us by email to fix it.A heads-up:Both PayPal and Stripe have their own security checks. If your payment goes through but you don’t get your membership benefits, please email us, and we’ll help you out.
reply8: During the development and maintenance of this website, we received tremendous help from the open-source community. We would like to extend our special thanks to the open-source project (https://github.com/zyddnys/manga-image-translator) manga-image-translator on GitHub, which is continuously maintained and updated by zyddnys. Manga-image-translator has provided strong support for our development work in image translation and manga processing. During implementation, we identified many areas for optimization and actively participated in modifying and improving the project. We are deeply grateful for the contributions and tireless efforts of the developers of this project to the open-source community. If you are interested in this project, feel free to visit the project page to learn more and get involved. Once again, our sincere thanks to zyddnys and all developers contributing to the open-source community!
